name: codex-dream-skin-studio
title_zh: 参考图变 Codex 皮肤，装坏了还能一键还原
tagline_zh: 丢一张图进去，它拆出配色、壁纸和图标，生成能双击安装的皮肤包；换之前先存好当前皮肤。
tagline_en: Drop in one image: it extracts palette, wallpaper and icons into a double-click theme pack, saving your current.
desc_en: Create and apply one-click Codex Dream Skin themes on macOS or Windows from a single reference image. Use when the user wants an image analyzed into a Codex UI skin, generated wallpaper and optional assets, a style-choice flow, a cross-platform theme pack, safe install/switch, or a double-click launcher that restores the latest saved skin after reopening Codex.
why_zh: 先分析再让你选风格，不是直接套模板；安装前自动备份，所以敢乱试。
why_en: It analyzes first and lets you pick a direction instead of forcing one template, and backs up before install so experimenting is.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Codex 这一个应用的界面换肤，改不了别的编辑器；参考图越干净效果越稳，杂乱截图会抽出脏配色。
limit_en: Only reskins the Codex app itself, not other editors; clean reference images work best, cluttered screenshots yield muddy palettes; ships theme.
title_en: Reference image to Codex skin, with one-click restore
